exposure: prolonged second stage of labour (>3 hours)
normal second stage of labour (≤3 hours)
outcome: incidence of spontaneous preterm birth at subsequent delivery
cohort: Primiparous women with term singleton pregnancies who reached the second stage of labour, identified from the McGill Obstetrical and Neonatal Database.
finding: A prolonged second stage of labour lasting more than three hours in the first delivery was not associated with preterm birth at their subsequent delivery.
gest_age: Term singleton pregnancies (for the first delivery)
